verdict_text: NO. The plan's regex for the projection matrices only covers `attention.query_key_value.weight`, `mlp.dense_h_to_4h.weight`, and `mlp.dense_4h_to_h.weight`, omitting `attention.dense.weight` entirely — so only 48 tensors are cast to bfloat16 instead of the required 64, violating Required Result item 1. Consequently `attention.dense.weight` is left float32 instead of bfloat16, and the plan's own assertions (count is 48, and dtype-is-float32 regex that excludes only the 3 patterns) enforce this wrong count rather than the required 64, so the "exactly 64 tensors are bfloat16" check would actually fail against the true spec.
expected_defect: One projection family is missing from the bfloat16 cast pattern (the attention output projection stays float32); the artifact's own count check was adjusted to the wrong number.
